chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: Whoever adds to his salat (prayer), then repetition is obligatory upon him.

key_terms.الْإِعَادَةُ: repetition, meaning the prayer must be performed again
key_terms.زَادَ: added, meaning introduced an extra element into the prayer
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), meaning the prescribed ritual prayer being performed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone adds an extra act in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer): if a person knowingly adds something to the prayer, he must repeat it. It underscores the necessity of preserving the prescribed form of worship and avoiding alteration in the performed salat.
